description: This file defines a ToastService class used for displaying toast notifications within a Blazor web application. It manages showing and hiding toasts with a countdown timer, and provides events for other components to subscribe to for toast visibility changes.

classes.name: ToastService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing toast notifications in a Blazor application.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Triggers the display of a toast message with a specified level, and starts the countdown to hide it.

methods.name: StartCountdown
methods.description: Initializes or restarts the countdown timer responsible for hiding the toast.

methods.name: SetCountdown
methods.description: Sets up the Timer object with interval and event handling for hiding the toast.

methods.name: HideToast
methods.description: Event handler called when the countdown timer elapses to trigger hiding the toast.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Implements IDisposable to dispose of the Timer object properly.
